    The surviving branch of a string-arrow cokernel #

    For a displayed arrow a : x ⟶ y, the radical of the Butler--Ringel module V(a) is obtained from the radical of the represented projective P(y) by deleting the coordinate indexed by a. Since a special-biserial vertex has at most two incoming arrows, at most one uniserial branch remains.
